english.title: Cause use of motor vehicle - fail to maintain windscreen wipers / washers
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on which not every windscreen

(A)_[wiper]_
(B)_[washer]_

was

(C)_[maintained in efficient working order]_
(D)_[properly adjusted]_
(E)_[maintained in efficient working order and properly adjusted]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 34(6)of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused the use on a road of a motor vehicle on which every windscreen wiper(s)/washer(s) was
not maintained in efficient working order or not properly adjusted or
maintained in efficient working order and properly adjusted

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This requirement does not apply to rear window wipers/washers.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings as follows: H126 and H247.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
